svg.aria-label: Weave, a spider, hangs at the centre of a web strung across a night sky. 8 green GPU chips, GPU 0 to GPU 7, sit at the ends of the spokes, and every spoke runs from a chip to the hub where Weave hangs. 4 silver knots on the spokes near the hub stand for the switches. With 1 thread from each chip to the hub, every GPU reaches every other through the hub, without a separate thread for each pair. A tag reads 1 link to the switch, not 7 to the others.
